description: WHAT: OSM Gebietspolygon for one Einsatzgebiet as GeoJSON FeatureCollection inside the MCP result. Same geometry as public GET https://maps.ikeytz.com/api/v1/embed/ort/{slug}/grenze (application/geo+json). Lookup slug|plz|name. RETURNS hasPolygon, polygon, point, osmRelationId/osmWayId, via, grenze_api, punkt_api. USE when the agent needs the boundary geometry. DOES NOT replace get_geo_api (URL pointers) or get_grenze_koordinaten (full embed blob). NEXT: get_grenze_koordinaten, get_lage, get_embed_map.

name.description: German place name substring (case-insensitive, umlauts ok), e.g. Grünbühl, Pattonville. Used when slug/plz omitted.

plz.description: German postcode (PLZ). Several Gebiete can share one PLZ (e.g. 71638). For single lookup first match wins; use find_by_plz for all matches.

slug.description: URL slug of one of the 52 Einsatzgebiete, e.g. pattonville, bietigheim-bissingen, walheim, gruenbuehl. Matches https://maps.ikeytz.com/{slug}. Lookup order when combined with plz/name: slug first.

name: get_grenze
title: Get Grenze
